reason: We do library storytime, parks and church groups, and I don't pay for kid stuff. I'd take the free first visit, but I'd still be chasing my kid around so the coffee is wasted on me, and $13 a visit is hard to justify when the park is free.
objection: I'll still be chasing my kid, so I won't really get to sit and drink coffee. Why pay $13 for that when the park and library cost nothing?
would_change_my_mind: If it were free or a couple dollars a visit, or if a church or moms group I'm already in booked it and I didn't have to pay myself.
